title: Shinonome Ena — Luxury Makeup Session〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Diner

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank goodness they had a big table available.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Yeah, we can finally sit down...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You have every reason to be tired since we were on our feet for most of the time while we took pictures.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You must be tired too, Kohane, Aoyagi.
Thanks for all your hard work.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Actually, I'm feeling okay.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you as well, Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, they won't be announcing the results for a little bit, so let's order some food and drinks while we can.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I might get a dessert. I'm really craving sugar right now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're getting dessert instead of real food? Don't come crying to me if you end up gaining weight.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, don't say stuff like that!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mmm! There's really nothing better than having something sweet after a hard day's work!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Mmm...! The chocolate parfait you recommended is so yummy, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Isn't it?
Pretty good for a diner, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What you got is really popular because it's only available around Valentine's Day.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Speaking of chocolate, Kohane, you guys entered that photo contest to win those chocolates by Couleur Chocolat, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanted to get them for An no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Their chocolates are supposed to be very good. I've seen them on TV several times.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Plus, the ones included in the prize are a collaboration exclusive. I'm guessing a lot of other people also want them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, they ran out seconds after they started taking orders.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But you also get a bunch of makeup in addition to those chocolates if you place in the top ten.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What are you going to do with your chocolates, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm thinking about sharing them with Akito and everyone else who's been helping us.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Really? Does that mean I don't have to give Akito any if I make it into the top ten too?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, you're gonna hog them for yourself?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, because they're probably not gonna make more of them.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Besides, I had my eyes set on that makeup, so I might give those chocolates to our mom.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I hope we both end up in the top ten.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know they're not announcing the results for a bit, but I'm already getting a little anxious...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I hope we get into the top ten...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We all did everything we could, so what's left for us to do now is believe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haruka's right.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I also agree. I'm sure we'll hear some good news considering how wonderful all our pictures were.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right! Thank you for the reassurance...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me...
There's something I've been meaning to ask you, Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Ask me?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Where did you learn to take pictures like that?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, from my dad, and some books on photography that I bought for myself.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I had no idea.
That explains why you're so good at framing things.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really? Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Actually, Ena, can I ask you a question about how you take selfies...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, sure. Ask away.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The truth is, I'm really bad at taking selfies...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's how we ended up asking Aoyagi to model for us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, that's understandable...
It's so hard to take selfies.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, that's hard for you because you still haven't really figured out how to use your phone.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why don't I take this opportunity to show you what I can? I know some neat tricks for taking pics with friends and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You'd do that?! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay! Let's start with the basics!
